plans.note: Section 15 is captioned 'Limitation of Garman's Liability' — likely one-sided in the Vendor's favour; check cap amount, exclusion of consequential damages and whether carve-outs (IP indemnity in sec-13, confidentiality in sec-14) sit outside the cap.

Section 13 is the IP indemnity from Garman. Confirm scope (defence plus indemnity, no cost-shifting to us), procedure, and that sec-15 does not cap or gut it; note any reciprocal indemnity we are asked to give.
No non-compete heading; restrictions on our business would most plausibly hide in sec-3 (Restrictions on Use) or the general matters clause. Confirm before marking missing.
Check the licence grant, use restrictions and maintenance/fees sections for any sole-source or exclusive-supply language binding us; none is signalled by the outline.
Fees (sec-11) and maintenance pricing (sec-10) are the only plausible homes for MFN language; only flag if an MFN runs against us.

Section 19 'Non-Solicitation of Employees' — test mutuality, duration, whether it covers all employees or only those engaged on the project, and whether general advertising/unsolicited applicants are carved out.

Section 17 governs term and termination; also review sec-7/sec-8 (option to reject software) and any maintenance termination right in sec-10 for whether we may exit on notice and whether Garman can terminate mid-term.
Auto-renewal of the maintenance term is most likely in sec-10 or sec-17; check notice window length and any uncapped renewal fee uplift in sec-11.
Governing law, venue and any arbitration clause should sit in the General Matters section (sec-20, continuing across sec-p0137/sec-p0148).
Assignment is typically in General Matters (sec-20); also check sec-2/sec-3 for transfer restrictions on the licence and whether our change of control triggers Garman's termination.

Ownership/reservation of rights likely in sec-2 and sec-3; confirm our data (including converted data under sec-4) and any customisations we pay for are not assigned to Garman, and that sec-14/sec-16 protect our materials.

Section 2 is the grant; check scope for affiliates/authorized locations, contractor and outsourcer use, perpetuity/irrevocability, and whether sec-3 narrows it unduly. Defined terms in sec-1 (authorized locations) matter here.
No audit heading; a usage-verification right would most likely appear inside sec-3 (Restrictions on Use) or General Matters. Check notice, frequency and cost allocation if present.
Look for interest on late fees, penalties or accelerated payments in sec-11 and termination consequences in sec-17; only flag liquidated damages running against us.

Section 12 (Specifications and Warranty) is primary; cross-check acceptance testing (sec-6), maintenance obligations (sec-10) for warranty duration and remedy, and sec-15 for any disclaimer of implied warranties.
No insurance heading; if absent from General Matters, treat as missing given Garman personnel attend our sites for installation (sec-4) and implementation (sec-9).
Check sec-11 for committed licence/maintenance fee volumes or minimum seat counts and sec-10 for a mandatory multi-year maintenance commitment with no exit.

Post-termination effects should be in sec-17 with survival in sec-18; escrow (sec-16) and the rejection/refund mechanics (sec-8) are partial substitutes. Confirm whether data return and migration assistance are addressed at all.
